Description

About Fabrikam Freight

You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams. The team ships weekly and keeps a short list of priorities that everyone can read. You will write clear requirements, review designs with engineers and check the result against the goal. Most of the work is turning vague requests into scoped, testable changes. We value plain writing, steady delivery and a habit of asking why before asking how. You will partner with support, finance and engineering leads to agree what ships next. Our customers are warehouse and logistics operators who need tools that simply work. You will measure adoption after each release and share what you learned with the team. This role reports to the head of the department and works across two time zones. We offer flexible hours, a learning budget and a quiet week at the end of each quarter.
